evals.prompt: I just installed Arch Linux and want a full Hyprland setup. I have a single 1920x1080 144Hz monitor, US keyboard, touchpad on a laptop. I want kitty as terminal, wofi as launcher, waybar as bar, dunst for notifications, hyprpaper for wallpaper, hyprlock for locking, hypridle for idle. Go with Catppuccin Mocha theme and JetBrainsMono Nerd Font. Include brightness and media keys.
evals.expected_output: A complete set of modular config files covering hyprland.conf, monitors.conf, autostart.conf, env.conf, keybinds.conf, windowrules.conf, animations.conf, hyprpaper.conf, hyprlock.conf, hypridle.conf, plus waybar/config.jsonc, waybar/style.css, dunst/dunstrc, wofi/config, wofi/style.css, kitty/kitty.conf, and an install.sh. All files should use Catppuccin Mocha colors consistently.

assertions.text: Output includes at minimum: hyprland.conf, monitors.conf, keybinds.conf, autostart.conf, env.conf
Output includes configs for at least 3 companion apps (waybar, dunst, wofi, kitty, hyprlock, hypridle, hyprpaper)
An install.sh script is generated that includes package installation commands
hyprlock.conf is generated (not just mentioned) — hyprlock requires a config to render
hypridle.conf is generated with at least one listener block
waybar config uses 'hyprland/workspaces' (not 'sway/workspaces')
Catppuccin Mocha colors are used (e.g. #1e1e2e background, #cdd6f4 text, or similar mocha palette)
XF86MonBrightnessUp and XF86MonBrightnessDown keybinds are present
XF86AudioRaiseVolume / XF86AudioLowerVolume / XF86AudioMute keybinds are present
A polkit agent is started in autostart (hyprpolkitagent or polkit-gnome)

evals.prompt:
I have two monitors: DP-1 is my primary 2560x1440 at 165Hz on the left, and HDMI-A-1 is a 1920x1080 60Hz monitor on the right. I want workspace 1-5 on DP-1 and 6-10 on HDMI-A-1. Here's my current monitor section:

monitor=,preferred,auto,1

Can you update it?
evals.expected_output: Corrected monitors.conf with explicit lines for DP-1 (2560x1440@165, 0x0) and HDMI-A-1 (1920x1080@60, 2560x0), plus workspace rules assigning 1-5 to DP-1 and 6-10 to HDMI-A-1.

assertions.text: Output contains a monitor line for DP-1 with 2560x1440@165
Output contains a monitor line for HDMI-A-1 with 1920x1080@60
DP-1 at x=0 (left), HDMI-A-1 at x=2560 (right)
Workspace rules assign 1-5 to DP-1 and 6-10 to HDMI-A-1
Scale factor is explicitly set for both monitors

evals.prompt: How do I make pavucontrol, nm-connection-editor, and blueman-manager all open as floating windows centered on screen? Also I want my browser (class: firefox) to always open on workspace 2.
evals.expected_output: windowrules.conf snippet with float+center rules for the 3 apps and a workspace rule for firefox, using modern windowrule {} block syntax.

assertions.text: Float rule applied to pavucontrol
Float rule applied to nm-connection-editor
Float rule applied to blueman-manager
Center rules applied to the floating apps
Firefox assigned to workspace 2
Uses modern windowrule { } block syntax, not deprecated 'windowrule = float, ^(class)$'

evals.prompt: I want a full Hyprland setup with Catppuccin Mocha, and I really want the bar to look polished — like the floating pill style I see in r/unixporn posts. Single 2560x1440 144Hz monitor, kitty, wofi, dunst, JetBrainsMono Nerd Font. hyprpaper for wallpaper, hyprlock, hypridle. US keyboard, no touchpad.
evals.expected_output: A complete Hyprland config set where the waybar config.jsonc and style.css are the standout — floating pill bar with transparent background, rounded module containers, Catppuccin Mocha @define-color palette, Nerd Font icons for every module, state-based styling (battery warning/critical, muted audio, disconnected network), and hover effects.

assertions.text: waybar style.css sets window#waybar background to transparent (not a solid color)
waybar style.css uses border-radius on module containers (modules-left/center/right or individual modules)
waybar style.css uses @define-color to define a color palette (at least 5 named colors)
waybar config.jsonc uses Nerd Font icons (unicode glyphs like , , , etc.) in module formats, not plain text labels
waybar config.jsonc includes margin-top or margin properties to create the floating effect
waybar config uses hyprland/workspaces (not sway/workspaces)
waybar style.css uses button.active for workspace styling (not button.focused)
waybar style.css includes state-based styling for at least 2 of: battery.warning, battery.critical, network.disconnected, pulseaudio.muted
waybar config includes at least 6 modules (workspaces, window, clock, pulseaudio/wireplumber, network, tray)

evals.prompt: I already have Hyprland configured but my waybar looks boring — it's just a flat grey bar with plain text. I want a modern floating pill bar with Gruvbox Dark colors, icons for each module, and a power button. Desktop, no battery needed. Just give me the waybar config.jsonc and style.css.
evals.expected_output: A standalone waybar config.jsonc and style.css pair with Gruvbox Dark colors defined via @define-color, floating pill design, Nerd Font icons, a custom/power module, and polished CSS with hover effects and state styling.

assertions.text: style.css defines Gruvbox Dark colors (e.g. #282828, #ebdbb2, #fb4934, #b8bb26, #fabd2f, #83a598, or similar gruvbox palette)
config.jsonc includes a custom/power module
config.jsonc does not include a battery module (user said desktop, no battery)
style.css creates a floating pill effect (transparent waybar background + rounded containers)
config.jsonc uses icon characters in module format strings (not plain text like 'Volume:' or 'CPU:')
Output contains only waybar config.jsonc and style.css (not a full Hyprland config set — user already has that)

evals.prompt: Setting up Hyprland on my laptop. Two monitors: eDP-1 (1920x1080 60Hz) built-in and DP-1 (2560x1440 165Hz) external on the right. I need waybar to show battery, backlight, wifi, bluetooth, volume, clock, workspaces. Tokyo Night theme, JetBrainsMono Nerd Font. I want each module to be its own individual pill/capsule — not grouped sections. Kitty terminal, wofi launcher, mako notifications, hyprlock, hypridle.
evals.expected_output: Full Hyprland config with a waybar that uses individual module pills (each module is its own rounded capsule with gaps between them), Tokyo Night colors, laptop modules (battery with states, backlight, wifi with signal strength, bluetooth). The CSS should style each module selector individually with background-color and border-radius rather than styling .modules-left/center/right.

assertions.text: waybar style.css applies background-color and border-radius to individual module selectors (#clock, #battery, #network, etc.) rather than only to .modules-left/.modules-center/.modules-right
waybar config includes a battery module with states (warning and/or critical thresholds)
waybar config includes a backlight module
waybar config includes a bluetooth module
style.css uses Tokyo Night colors (e.g. #1a1b26, #a9b1d6, #7aa2f7, #bb9af7, #9ece6a, or similar)
monitors.conf or hyprland.conf includes correct monitor lines for eDP-1 (1920x1080@60) and DP-1 (2560x1440@165) with DP-1 to the right
waybar network module format includes signal strength ({signalStrength}) for wifi

evals.prompt: Full Hyprland setup on Arch. Single 2560x1440 165Hz monitor, desktop (no touchpad/battery). Catppuccin Mocha, kitty, wofi, waybar, dunst, hyprpaper, hyprlock, hypridle. For the shell: I want zsh with starship prompt, syntax highlighting and autosuggestions, plus the modern CLI tools (eza, bat, fd, ripgrep, fzf, zoxide, fastfetch, btop). Set up aliases for all of them. No display manager — I'll launch from TTY.
evals.expected_output: A full Hyprland config set plus: a .zshrc with starship init, plugin sourcing (zsh-syntax-highlighting, zsh-autosuggestions), zoxide init, fzf init, and aliases for eza/bat/fd/rg/etc. A starship.toml with Catppuccin Mocha palette. A TTY auto-launch line in .zprofile. install.sh includes zsh, starship, zsh plugins, CLI utilities, and chsh -s /usr/bin/zsh.

assertions.text: A .zshrc file is generated (not just mentioned)
.zshrc contains 'eval "$(starship init zsh)"' or equivalent starship initialization
.zshrc sources zsh-syntax-highlighting plugin
.zshrc sources zsh-autosuggestions plugin
A starship.toml config file is generated
starship.toml includes Catppuccin Mocha colors or palette reference
.zshrc contains aliases for at least 3 of: eza, bat, fd, ripgrep/rg, zoxide, btop
.zshrc contains zoxide initialization (eval "$(zoxide init zsh)" or similar)
A .zprofile is generated with Hyprland TTY auto-launch line
install.sh includes zsh, starship, eza, bat, fd, ripgrep, fzf, zoxide, fastfetch, btop in package list
install.sh includes chsh command to set zsh as default shell

evals.prompt: I'm setting up Hyprland on Arch with fish shell. I want fish with starship prompt, fisher plugin manager with the fzf plugin, and the usual modern CLI tools (eza, bat, fzf, zoxide). Use Catppuccin Mocha theme everywhere. Kitty terminal, waybar, wofi, dunst. Single 1920x1080 monitor. I use uwsm to start Hyprland.
evals.expected_output: A full Hyprland config set plus: a config.fish with starship init, zoxide init, fish abbreviations (not bash aliases) for eza/bat/etc. install.sh includes fish, starship, fisher setup, and CLI tools. Since using uwsm, env vars go in uwsm/env files, not env.conf. No TTY launch line needed (uwsm handles session).

assertions.text: A config.fish file is generated (at ~/.config/fish/config.fish)
config.fish contains 'starship init fish | source' for prompt initialization
config.fish uses 'abbr' for tool shortcuts (not bash-style 'alias')
config.fish contains 'zoxide init fish | source' for directory jumping
install.sh or instructions include fisher installation and 'fisher install PatrickF1/fzf.fish'
Any environment variables in config.fish use Fish syntax (set -gx) not bash export syntax
Environment variables are placed in uwsm/env files (not env.conf in hyprland config)
install.sh includes fish, starship, eza, bat, fzf, zoxide in package list

evals.prompt: Full Hyprland setup on Arch. Single 3440x1440 144Hz ultrawide, desktop. I want rofi-wayland as my launcher (not wofi), swaync for notifications (I want the full notification center with media controls and DND toggle), and wlogout for my power menu. Catppuccin Mocha, JetBrainsMono Nerd Font, kitty, waybar (floating pill style), hyprlock, hypridle, hyprpaper. Moderate blur, 10px rounding, smart gaps.
evals.expected_output: A complete Hyprland config set with: rofi config.rasi + theme file with Catppuccin Mocha colors, swaync config.json (with mpris and dnd widgets) + style.css with full themed CSS, wlogout layout + style.css with themed buttons. Waybar should have a custom/swaync toggle button and a custom/power button for wlogout. Layer rules for blur on rofi and swaync.

assertions.text: A rofi config.rasi or theme .rasi file is generated (not wofi config)
rofi theme uses Catppuccin Mocha colors (e.g. #1e1e2e, #cba6f7, #cdd6f4)
swaync config.json is generated with a widgets array
swaync config.json includes 'mpris' in the widgets array for media controls
swaync config.json includes 'dnd' in the widgets array
swaync style.css is generated with themed selectors (.control-center, .notification, etc.)
wlogout layout file is generated as a JSON array with button objects (lock, logout, reboot, shutdown at minimum)
wlogout style.css is generated with per-button styling
waybar config includes a custom module for toggling swaync (using swaync-client)
waybar config includes a custom/power module that launches wlogout
Hyprland config includes a layerrule for blur on rofi
Hyprland config includes a layerrule for blur on swaync-control-center

evals.prompt: I already have Hyprland running with hyprpaper but I want to switch to swww for animated wallpaper transitions. I have a folder of wallpapers at ~/Pictures/wallpapers/. I want: swww set up in autostart (replacing hyprpaper), a script that cycles through wallpapers randomly every 5 minutes with a fade transition, and a keybind (SUPER+W) to immediately switch to a random wallpaper with a wipe transition. Just give me the swww-related files, not a full config.
evals.expected_output: Updated autostart lines (swww-daemon replacing hyprpaper), a wallpaper cycling shell script, and a keybind snippet. The script should use swww img with transition flags.

assertions.text: Output includes exec-once = swww-daemon (or swww-daemon with initial wallpaper)
Output mentions removing or replacing the hyprpaper autostart line
A shell script is generated that cycles through wallpapers in ~/Pictures/wallpapers/
The cycling script uses --transition-type fade (or similar smooth transition)
The cycling script uses a 300 second (5 minute) interval
A keybind for SUPER+W is generated that triggers a random wallpaper change
The keybind wallpaper script uses --transition-type wipe
Output focuses on swww-related files only (not a full Hyprland config rewrite)

evals.prompt: I need just a fuzzel config for my Hyprland setup. I'm using Gruvbox Dark colors, JetBrainsMono Nerd Font size 12, Papirus icons. I want it to feel minimal — no thick borders, subtle rounded corners. Also give me the Hyprland layerrule for blur on it.
evals.expected_output: A fuzzel.ini config file with Gruvbox Dark colors in RRGGBBAA format, the specified font, Papirus icons, thin border, and a layerrule snippet.

assertions.text: A fuzzel.ini config file is generated
Colors section uses Gruvbox Dark palette (e.g. 282828 for background, ebdbb2 for text)
Colors are in RRGGBBAA format (8 hex chars, no # prefix) as fuzzel requires
Font is set to JetBrainsMono Nerd Font with size 12
icon-theme is set to Papirus
Output includes a layerrule for blur on the launcher layer namespace
Output is a standalone fuzzel config (not a full Hyprland setup)
